scope: Source-informed development comparison of unchanged automatic measurements against the manual-ridge baseline. Neither regional bounds, event selection nor fine search are blind.

review.basis: Source-informed acoustic review: group identities already matched to main recording events in original-hour-evaluation-001. No new flight-search result is used to choose, trim or rescale a ridge.

cases.scope: All 6661 original regional continuous tracks and 2856 original 200m terrain observers. Both measured ridges replaced; all source-informed model, timing, f0 and coarse gates unchanged.
Conditional comparison on the manual baseline pair (2 tracks) and its existing 169-point 25m grid. Not independent pair recovery or automatic refinement.

software_integrity_gates: Review is explicitly an agent/source-informed selection, not user or human approval.
Exactly the two frozen measured ridges are transferred in full with identical ordered times and frequencies; gaps are not interpolated, traces are not clipped, harmonics are not rescaled or pooled.
All tracks, observers, coarse/model/clock/separation settings and explicit emitted-frequency lists match the frozen template.
Discovery, review, contract, executable and input source hashes are unchanged after execution.
Native outputs are well formed; no candidate returns exit3 and zero rows, a ranked result returns exit0 and coherent finite rows.
Every result and comparison remains location_verified=false.

scientific_outcomes.no_candidate: Report an inconclusive matching outcome; technical transfer success does not establish a location.
scientific_outcomes.differences: Report WGS84 distance from the manual winner and both external references, flight-pair agreement, shared-clock and per-event/full score diagnostics. Different point sets mean RMSE is not a direct improvement comparison.
scientific_outcomes.edge_check: Report winning observer on latitude/longitude range boundary or shared-clock sweep boundary; do not enlarge, retune or rerun based on result.
scientific_outcomes.weak_event: The faint event was missed by automatic discovery and is outside this two-event comparison.

evaluation_isolation: Input templates contain inherited search settings and manual events, but the bridge replaces those event points in full before native ranking; manual points do not contribute to the new scores. Baseline results and external coordinates are hashed as opaque bytes before the run and parsed only after both new predictions finish. This is procedural separation on one filesystem, not a sealed holdout.
